text: So sorry to be messaging at this hour, I know you must be really busy and this is probably nothing. My daughter Isla is 4 and her temperature has just come up at 39.7, which made me panic a bit because it's the highest she's had. She's had a runny, stuffy nose all day and she's been sneezing loads, so I'm assuming it's a cold she's picked up from nursery. The other thing, and sorry if this is too much info, is she hasn't done a poo for three days now and she's really grumpy about it, keeps saying her bum won't work. Then about an hour ago she just flopped on the sofa and wouldn't move, and honestly my heart jumped a bit. But it's been a long day, we were out at a party this afternoon, and when I gave her a nudge she woke straight up and started telling me all about the cake and asked for her teddy, totally normal Isla. I think she's just shattered. I just wanted to check whether 39.7 is something I should be worried about on its own, and whether there's anything I can do for the poo situation. Sorry again for bothering you, thank you for being there.
